single.rationale: California Water Service shows steady revenue growth (7.6% 3-year CAGR) and solid fundamentals as a regulated utility, but faces material near-term headwinds including regulatory uncertainty around the pending 2024 CA GRC decision, one-time 2024 benefits ($88.6M IRMA revenue) that won't recur, and declining profitability (operating margin compressed from 24.9% in 2024 to 17.7% in 2025). The regulatory asset recovery model provides stability but creates execution risk, and rising debt levels ($1.5B vs $1.1B three years ago) amid higher interest costs warrant monitoring before deeper commitment.
